args.goal:
P3 CUT THE VENDOR BACKEND in the git worktree E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3 (branch p3-backend). ALL reads, edits and test runs happen ONLY under E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3 (never E:/research-clones/hypergen, where a parallel P1 rebrand team works). Read first: E:/research-clones/docs/agents/P3-providers.md (researched API facts: fal.ai catalog + queue API, Gemini generateContent with gemini-flash-latest, transformers.js Whisper word timestamps, key storage design) and ADR-011 in E:/research-clones/docs/agents/ADR.md.

GOAL: Hypergen is local-first; no tie to the old vendor servers; every editor feature keeps working.
1) REMOVE: Supabase auth (apps/web/src/context/auth.tsx, pages/login.tsx, AuthGate in app.tsx: the app must open straight into the dashboard/editor with no sign-in), tRPC client lib/api.ts, lib/jobs.ts remote jobs, lib/checkout.ts, lib/analytics.ts and apps/desktop/src/analytics.ts (+ all call sites; no telemetry at all), Sentry init in apps/web/src/index.tsx (and the @sentry dependency), billing/plans/credits/invoices/account dashboard views and their sidebar entries, upgrade-dialog.tsx, purchase-success.tsx, credit estimates/maxCredits, public/auth and public/checkout callback pages, the auth deep-link handling in main process if it only served auth/checkout, VITE_SUPABASE_*/VITE_API_URL in apps/web/.env.example and code, and the npm dependency @diffusionstudio/api-contract (write our own small types/catalog in packages/dapi/src/models.ts; do not copy that package's code).
2) ADD Settings > 'AI providers' panel (dashboard settings): Gemini key and fal.ai key, a 'Get a key' link each (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey, https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys), Save, Remove, Test. Keys stored by Electron main with safeStorage in <userData>/keys.json; renderer only learns {gemini:boolean, fal:boolean}. Provider HTTP calls run in main over IPC.
3) transcribe (dapi handler + auto-captions command): local Whisper via @huggingface/transformers in the renderer, onnx-community/whisper-base_timestamped, word timestamps, webgpu with wasm fallback, progress reporting; output in the exact transcript shape existing captions code consumes. No key needed.
4) listen (dapi handler): Gemini generateContent via main IPC with inline base64 media + question; >20MB -> clear error.
5) generate (dapi tool + genai UI + command palette AI commands: generate, edit-with-prompt, remove-background, upscale): fal.ai queue API via main IPC; a vendored Hypergen catalog of ~10-12 models with endpoint ids VERIFIED via GET https://api.fal.ai/v1/models?q=<term> (image: nano-banana-pro + /edit, a flux; video: kling v3 pro t2v+i2v, veo3.1 fast, a seedance; voice/music/sfx if available; bria background removal; seedvr upscale). Local files sent as data URIs (>10MB clear error). Keep sam-2.1 local model working. Update docs/reference/models.md and tools docs for the new catalog (no credits).
6) Missing key -> error code MISSING_KEY, message 'Add your <Gemini|fal.ai> API key in Hypergen > Settings > AI providers.' visible to UI and MCP agents.
7) Remove the dashboard/UI surfaces that only existed for the vendor (Get credits, Upgrade, plans), but keep MCP setup, projects, settings, help.

CONSTRAINTS: YAGNI; delete rather than flag. Plan at most 8 work packages (each may touch up to ~10 files) so the team stays small. Minimize edits to these files the P1 team is also rebranding (only the lines you must change): apps/web/src/components/dashboard/sidebar.tsx, apps/web/src/app.tsx, apps/web/index.html, apps/desktop/src/main.ts, apps/desktop/forge.config.ts, docs/reference/tools/*.md. Name things 'Hypergen'. Tests: add focused vitest tests (key store with safeStorage mocked, MISSING_KEY errors, fal request/poll/result parsing with fetch mocked, Gemini request shape, catalog ids unique, whisper output -> transcript shape mapping). Baseline pre-existing failures: apps/desktop window-host.test.ts x2, projects.drafts.test.ts x2 (Windows-only); npm run check pre-existing error packages/assets/src/browser.ts showSaveFilePicker. Acceptance overall: npm test no new failures, npm run check no new errors, `git grep -nIi "supabase\|sentry\|api.diffusion\|api-contract\|credits"` in the worktree returns nothing outside allowed docs history. Commit nothing; the orchestrator commits.

questions: Generation history: fal has no 'get job by id' without the stored queue URLs, so this plan keeps fal jobs in memory for the session only. As a result, Reuse settings, Rerun and the asset-info job details work only for jobs made in the current session. Is that acceptable, or should job requests be saved (for example in the project's assets manifest) so they survive a restart?

fal.ai key 'Test' button: the P3 brief does not name an endpoint that checks a fal key. The plan uses an authenticated fal request that is checked by hand to return 401/403 for a bad key. If no such cheap endpoint exists, can Test just report 'saved' for fal, so the key is only proven on the first generate?
Whisper runs in the renderer main thread (YAGNI). With the wasm fallback (no WebGPU), a long transcription can freeze the editor UI. Is that acceptable for P3, or must it run in a Web Worker now?

The acceptance grep `git grep -i sentry` always matches the unrelated identifiers FsEntry and webkitGetAsEntry ('sEntry'). The plan treats these as allowed hits. Confirm, or should the check use word boundaries?

subtasks.title: packages/dapi core: Hypergen model catalog, job/transcript types, MISSING_KEY, Whisper-to-transcript mapping; drop @diffusionstudio/api-contract from dapi and CLI
acceptance: All work only under E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3. Before writing any endpoint id, run GET https://api.fal.ai/v1/models?q=<term>&limit=50 and use only endpoint_id values that the response returns with an active status; record the verify date in a comment in models.ts.

models.ts is our own code (not copied from api-contract). It exports: HYPERGEN_MODELS (about 10-12 entries: nano-banana-pro with a text endpoint and the /edit endpoint used when images are given; one flux image model; kling v3 pro with t2v and i2v endpoints chosen by startFrame; veo3.1 fast (t2v + i2v); one seedance; an ElevenLabs TTS, music and sfx if fal lists them; bria background removal; seedvr image upscale, and seedvr video upscale only if fal lists it), MODEL_IDS, ModelId, Resolution, PromptMode/kind per model, a static etaSeconds per model, a pure toFalInput(request) per model that maps our request fields (prompt, images, aspectRatio, resolution, duration, count, voice, startFrame, endFrame, image, video) to that model's fal input field names (checked against the fal openapi via &expand=openapi-3.0), plus types GenerateRequest, Job ({id, model, request, status queued|running|succeeded|failed|canceled, etaSeconds, etaRemainingSeconds, phase, progress, assets[{url, filename, mimeType}], error{code,message}|null, createdAt}) and Transcript = TranscriptSegment[].

models.test.ts: catalog ids are unique; every fal endpoint id is unique per entry and matches /^[a-z0-9-]+\/[\w./-]+$/; no catalog id collides with LOCAL_MODEL_IDS (sam-2.1); toFalInput for nano-banana-pro with images selects the /edit endpoint and with no images the text endpoint; kling with startFrame selects i2v.

errors.ts: DapiErrorCode adds "MISSING_KEY" and removes "sign-in-required". A helper missingKey(provider: 'gemini'|'fal') returns a DapiError with code MISSING_KEY and message exactly 'Add your Gemini API key in Hypergen > Settings > AI providers.' / 'Add your fal.ai API key in Hypergen > Settings > AI providers.'; a helper fromWireError(message) turns a main-process error string that starts with 'MISSING_KEY: ' back into that DapiError (other strings -> plain Error). Both exported from index.ts and covered by a vitest test.

transcript.ts exports a pure whisperToTranscript(chunks: {text: string; timestamp: [number, number|null]}[], duration: number): TranscriptSegment[] (words trimmed, empty words dropped, a null end becomes the next word's start or duration, segments split on sentence-ending punctuation or a gap > 1 s). transcript.test.ts checks the exact output shape {text, words:[{text,start,end}]} that tools/transcribe.ts TranscriptSegment parses, including the null-end case and the empty-input case (returns []).

tools/generate.ts imports nothing from @diffusionstudio/api-contract; model enum = MODEL_IDS + LOCAL_MODEL_IDS; maxCredits and every credits field are gone; `estimate` returns only {etaSeconds}; GenerationEstimate in index.ts no longer mentions credits; description names Hypergen, the user's fal.ai key and MISSING_KEY, and says nothing about accounts or credits. local/fields.ts drops maxCredits.
apps/cli/src/index.ts drops --max-credits (keeps --estimate).
@diffusionstudio/api-contract removed from packages/dapi/package.json. `git grep -nIi "api-contract\|credits\|sign-in-required" -- packages/dapi apps/cli` returns nothing.
`npm test -w packages/dapi` passes (tools.test.ts updated to the new catalog and estimate shape).
subtasks.tools: Read/Grep, WebFetch (or curl) for https://api.fal.ai/v1/models?q=...; vitest

subtasks.title: Desktop main: remove analytics + auth/checkout deep links; add safeStorage key store and fal/Gemini provider IPC with tests
acceptance: main.ts: no analytics import/calls, no AUTH_PROTOCOL/setAsDefaultProtocolClient, no deep-link routing (pendingDeepLinks, deliverDeepLink, open-url/second-instance link handling; second-instance still focuses the window), no ANALYTICS_CONFIGURE/AUTH_*/CHECKOUT_* handlers; adds one call that registers provider handlers. main-channels.ts drops ANALYTICS_CONFIGURE, AUTH_*, CHECKOUT_*, DeepLinkChannel and adds PROVIDERS_KEYS_STATUS, PROVIDERS_KEYS_SET, PROVIDERS_KEYS_REMOVE, PROVIDERS_KEYS_TEST, PROVIDERS_FAL_SUBMIT, PROVIDERS_FAL_POLL, PROVIDERS_FAL_CANCEL, PROVIDERS_GEMINI_GENERATE with typed request/response entries. dapi/server.ts drops TrackProps/onToolCall.

keys.ts: keys stored per provider ('gemini'|'fal') as safeStorage.encryptString base64 in <userData>/keys.json (path injected for tests), written atomically; status() returns only {gemini:boolean, fal:boolean}; no channel ever returns a raw key. keys.test.ts (safeStorage + fs temp dir mocked) covers set -> status true, file content is not the plain key, remove -> status false, corrupt/missing file -> both false, and safeStorage unavailable -> clear error.

fal.ts (fetch injected): submit POSTs https://queue.fal.run/{endpoint} with headers Authorization 'Key <key>' and Content-Type application/json, body = input, keeps {status_url, response_url, cancel_url} by request_id in memory; poll GETs the stored status_url and returns {status: IN_QUEUE|IN_PROGRESS|COMPLETED, queuePosition?, error?}, and on COMPLETED without error GETs response_url and returns files[] collected from images[], image, video, audio (each {url, contentType, fileName}); cancel PUTs cancel_url. fal.test.ts covers request shape, each status, the error case, result parsing of images[]/video/audio, and unknown request id.

gemini.ts (fetch injected): POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-flash-latest:generateContent with header x-goog-api-key and body {contents:[{parts:[{inline_data:{mime_type, data:<base64>}}, {text: prompt}]}]}; returns the joined candidate text; media > 20 MB is rejected before fetch with a clear message. gemini.test.ts asserts the exact URL, header and body shape, the 20 MB error, and a non-200 error message.
A missing key in any provider call throws an Error whose message is 'MISSING_KEY: ' + the WP1 missingKey(provider).message (tested for both providers, and fetch is not called).

PROVIDERS_KEYS_TEST: Gemini does an authenticated GET https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models; fal uses an authenticated request verified by hand to return 401/403 on a bad key (documented in a code comment); returns {ok:boolean, error?:string}.
present.ts toErrorResult: for a DapiError with code MISSING_KEY the text is 'MISSING_KEY: <message>' so MCP agents see the code; present.test.ts has no credits field and covers this case.
`npm test -w apps/desktop`: only the 4 baseline failures (window-host x2, projects.drafts x2); `git grep -nIi "analytics\|api-contract\|credits" -- apps/desktop/src` returns nothing.

subtasks.title: Dashboard: delete billing/plans/credits/invoices/account views and their nav; add Settings > AI providers panel
files: E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3/apps/web/src/lib/providers.ts (new: renderer wrapper over the PROVIDERS_* channels)
acceptance: DashboardView has no 'ai-credits'|'billing'|'account'; it adds 'ai-providers'. Settings nav lists General, AI providers, MCP & CLI, Help (no Account, AI credits, Billing); the sidebar Settings row opens 'settings'. Home, projects, drafts, collections, MCP setup and help still render.
shared.tsx keeps only non-billing helpers (no DashboardPlanDetails/FreePlan/PaidPlan/PlanSummary, no checkout/api/auth imports); project-menu/index.tsx has no AI credits submenu.

ai-providers-view.tsx shows a row per provider (Gemini, fal.ai) with a password input, Save, Remove, Test, a status of 'Saved'/'Not set' from PROVIDERS_KEYS_STATUS, and a 'Get a key' link opened with APP_OPEN_EXTERNAL to https://aistudio.google.com/apikey and https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys. The input clears after Save; the raw key is never read back. Test shows the {ok,error} result in a toast. In a browser build (no window.desktop) the panel says keys need the desktop app.

lib/providers.ts exports keyStatus(), setKey(), removeKey(), testKey(), falSubmit(), falPoll(), falCancel(), geminiGenerate(); every call maps a 'MISSING_KEY: ' error through fromWireError (WP1) so callers get DapiError code MISSING_KEY.
`git grep -nIi "credits\|checkout\|billing\|invoice\|planName" -- apps/web/src/components/dashboard apps/web/src/pages apps/web/src/components/sidebar-left apps/web/public` returns nothing.
subtasks.tools: Grep; manual run of the desktop app to click Save/Remove/Test

subtasks.title: Generation core on fal.ai: replace tRPC api/jobs/uploads with main-IPC fal jobs; dapi generate/job handlers; remove upgrade dialog
files: E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3/apps/web/src/dapi/lib/remote.ts (delete or reduce to provider error mapping)
acceptance: lib/uploads.ts: uploadFile(blob) returns a data: URI string; a blob > 10 MB throws DapiError invalid-input with a message naming the 10 MB limit; no network call.

lib/jobs.ts: runJob(request, onUpdate, signal) looks up the model in HYPERGEN_MODELS, calls falSubmit(endpoint, toFalInput(request)), polls falPoll about every 1 s, maps fal states to the WP1 Job shape (IN_QUEUE->queued, IN_PROGRESS->running, COMPLETED->succeeded or failed with error), calls falCancel on abort, and keeps jobs of this session in a Map so getJob(id) works for later callers; jobFailure() kept. Missing fal key rejects with DapiError MISSING_KEY before any submit.

dapi/handlers/generate.ts: no requireSignIn, no api import, no maxCredits; estimate returns {etaSeconds} from the catalog; job(id, cancel) works for fal jobs via lib/jobs and for local jobs unchanged; sam-2.1 local jobs still start and poll (local/jobs.ts has no api-contract import and no credits field).
engine/generate/run.tsx: no TRPCClientError/PAYMENT_REQUIRED branch; a MISSING_KEY failure shows a toast with the exact message 'Add your fal.ai API key in Hypergen > Settings > AI providers.'.
asset-info.tsx and reuse-settings.tsx read the job from lib/jobs getJob(id) and degrade quietly (no error toast) when the job is not known this session.

@trpc/client, @trpc/server and @diffusionstudio/api-contract removed from apps/web/package.json; npm install run. `git grep -nI "@/lib/api\|@trpc\|api-contract\|requireSignIn\|showUpgradeDialog" -- apps/web` returns nothing.

Manual check in the desktop app with a real fal key: one image prompt lands on the canvas and the file is in the library (if the renderer fetch of the fal media URL is blocked, download it in main instead and note it).

subtasks.title: Genai UI and AI commands on the new catalog: prompt box, model menu, transforms, rerun; no credits anywhere
acceptance: config.ts MODEL_MODES/MODEL_OPTIONS/DEFAULT_MODELS use only WP1 ModelId values, with aspect ratios, durations, resolutions, references and voices that match each fal model's openapi input; modes with no catalog model are hidden from PROMPT_INPUT_MODE_OPTIONS.
requests.ts toRequest/toConfig/outputOf type-check against the WP1 GenerateRequest and still produce a request per prompt-box setting.
use-transforms.ts: upscale uses the seedvr image endpoint (and the video one only if the catalog has it; else upscale takes images only); remove background uses the bria entry; no price/chargeOf.
Command palette commands generate, edit-with-prompt, remove-background, upscale, auto-captions, rerun, reuse-settings stay registered and enabled for valid selections.

No CreditsTag, ActionBarCredits, formatCost, priceOf, totalCredits, 'AI credits used' or 'ai-credits' icon remain; context/commands.tsx has no credits?() field. `git grep -nIi "credit\|estimate\|api-contract" -- apps/web/src/components/genai apps/web/src/components/commands apps/web/src/components/canvas apps/web/src/context` returns nothing.
npm run check shows no errors in these files.

subtasks.title: Local Whisper transcribe (dapi handler + auto-captions) and Gemini listen
acceptance: lib/whisper.ts: transcribe(blob, {signal, onProgress}) decodes the audio to 16 kHz mono Float32Array (AudioContext/OfflineAudioContext, channels averaged), loads pipeline('automatic-speech-recognition','onnx-community/whisper-base_timestamped') once with device 'webgpu' and falls back to 'wasm' if that throws, runs {return_timestamps:'word', chunk_length_s:30}, reports model download progress (0..1) through onProgress, and returns whisperToTranscript(chunks, duration) from WP1. No key, no network except the Hugging Face model download.

dapi transcribe handler: no requireSignIn/runJob/uploadFile/api-contract; keeps the per-sha256 session cache and the 'No speech detected' error; returns {segments} that parse with the transcribe tool's result schema.

captions.tsx: uses lib/whisper.ts on encodeSceneAudio output, shows progress (shimmer stays; a toast or label shows model download percent), stores the transcript JSON array in the library and mounts <captions> exactly as before.

dapi listen handler: no requireSignIn/runJob/uploadFile; sends the (windowed) audio bytes and prompt through geminiGenerate (WP4 lib/providers.ts); audio > 20 MB throws DapiError invalid-input with a clear message telling the user to pass a shorter start/end window; result shape {result[, start, end]} unchanged; a missing Gemini key surfaces DapiError MISSING_KEY with 'Add your Gemini API key in Hypergen > Settings > AI providers.'.
@huggingface/transformers added to apps/web/package.json and npm install run; npm run check shows no errors in these files.
Manual check in the desktop app: auto-captions on a scene with speech produces word-timed captions without any key set.

subtasks.title: Docs and tool descriptions for the new catalog (no credits, no accounts) and final acceptance sweep
files: E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3/docs/reference/tools/{generate,job,transcribe,listen,README,check,grab,filmstrip,probe,waveform,segment}.md (only lines that mention credits/accounts/sign-in/API models; P1 also edits these)
acceptance: models.md lists exactly the WP1 catalog (Hypergen id, display name, fal endpoint ids, fields and allowed values) plus local sam-2.1; says generation uses the user's fal.ai key, transcribe runs locally with Whisper, listen uses the user's Gemini key; no credits, accounts or upstream model ids.

generate.md/job.md: maxCredits, credits and sign-in-required removed; MISSING_KEY documented with the exact messages; estimate documented as {etaSeconds}; files described as data URIs with the 10 MB limit. transcribe/listen docs and tool descriptions mention local Whisper / Gemini key and the 20 MB limit.
Tool description strings that said 'no credits' now say 'local' only.

Overall: `npm test` has no failures beyond the 4 baseline desktop failures; `npm run check` has no errors beyond the baseline packages/assets/src/browser.ts showSaveFilePicker error; `git grep -nIi "supabase\|sentry\|api.diffusion\|api-contract\|credits"` in E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3 returns only the substring hits FsEntry / webkitGetAsEntry ("sEntry") and nothing else.
Nothing is committed.
